notes.title: patch fixes
notes.notes: Hey there! This small patch fixes a number of typos in the Russian version of the game as well as the background slicing issue. An update for other languages is scheduled for later this week.

notes.title: Release date for EP. 4!
notes.notes:
Release date for EP. 4!
Episode 4: Stomp Your Hooves In Wait will be up on May 31st.
Everybody who already owns the game will get the new episode as a free update.
We've been working hard and listening to your feedback, so we've added a lot more new save slots for all your needs.
There will also be a "Set To Default" button in the options menu for the best audio experience.
Oh, and most importantly, due to the presence of extreme violence in Episode 4, it's not recommended to anyone younger than 18.

notes.title: Episode 3 release date!
notes.notes:
Yes, the title doesn't lie, this is the official announcement of the release date for Episode 3! We know you've been patiently waiting for more Tiny Bunny so we couldn't let ourselves delay the new episode into 2022. Which means, everyone who already owns the game will get it on December 31st, absolutely free of charge! 
The only sad news here is that, because of certain technical difficulties, your saves from the previous version won't work so you'll have to replay everything up to Episode 3, or manually skip the text by checking the 'skip all text' box in the options and pressing the 'Ctrl' key. We're very sorry about the inconvenience.
